candidate_workaround: Use non-terminating PowerShell handling around native unittest output, capture the complete stream, and decide success only from the explicit native exit code.
failure_signature: A precommit scoped unittest wrapper used terminating PowerShell error handling, so unittest's normal stderr progress stream became a NativeCommandError before the wrapper could inspect the successful process exit code.
recurrence_guard: For native tools that legitimately write progress to stderr under Windows PowerShell 5.1, capture output with non-terminating handling and gate solely on LASTEXITCODE plus parsed totals.
rollback: Retain the interrupted wrapper with zero aggregate credit and change no repository evidence until one complete exit-code-governed selection passes.
scope_boundary: Same-owner PowerShell native-output recovery only; no scientific, professional, legal, cultural, Maori-authority, production, security, accessibility, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Judge unittest by native exit code under PowerShell 5.1
trigger_preconditions: A native test runner writes normal progress to stderr while PowerShell terminating error handling is active.
